short_description: A standing or hinged rear-delt fly that strengthens the upper back and improves posture.
how_to: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hinge forward slightly.
Hold your arms out to the sides with a soft bend at the elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together as you raise your arms.
Lower your arms slowly back to the start.
Repeat for the target reps.
correct: Keep your chest up and back flat.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows throughout.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Move at a controlled pace.
mistakes: Don't round your upper back.
Don't swing your arms with momentum.
Don't shrug your shoulders up.
Don't lock your elbows straight.

short_description: A shadowboxing hook punch that trains shoulder rotation and upper-body power.
how_to: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Raise your fists to guard position near your chin.
Drive your right fist in a horizontal arc at shoulder height, rotating your torso.
Return to guard, then repeat on the left side.
Alternate sides with a steady rhythm.
correct: Keep your core braced on each punch.
Rotate your torso to power each hook.
Keep your non-punching hand at your chin.
Keep your feet planted and stable.
mistakes: Don't punch above your shoulder line.
Don't drop your guard hand while punching.
Don't tense your neck and shoulders.
Don't lean forward off your base.

short_description: A crunch combined with a bicep curl motion that targets the abs and arms together.
how_to: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Hold your arms along your sides with your palms facing up.
Curl your shoulders off the floor while curling your forearms toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Repeat for the target reps.
correct: Keep your lower back controlled.
Keep your chin off your chest.
Curl with control on the way up and down.
Breathe out as you crunch up.
mistakes: Don't arch your lower back.
Don't pull on your neck.
Don't jerk upward with momentum.
Don't hold your breath.

short_description: A rotating dumbbell press that works the front and side deltoids through a full arc of motion.
how_to: Sit or stand with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing you.
Press the dumbbells upward while rotating your palms to face forward.
Extend your arms fully overhead.
Reverse the rotation as you lower the dumbbells back to the start.
Repeat in a smooth, controlled cycle.
correct: Keep your core engaged throughout.
Keep your elbows tracked under the weights.
Rotate your wrists smoothly and evenly.
Keep your lower back from arching.
mistakes: Don't press with a jerky motion.
Don't shrug your shoulders at the top.
Don't arch your lower back.
Don't rush the rotation.

short_description: A shoulder mobility drill that circles the arms in opposite directions to loosen the joints and warm up the deltoids.
how_to: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Circle one arm forward and the other arm backward at the same time.
Keep the circles smooth and even.
Switch directions after the target reps.
correct: Keep your chest open and your back straight.
Keep the circles the same size on each side.
Relax your neck and jaw.
Move at a steady, controlled pace.
mistakes: Don't hunch your shoulders up toward your ears.
Don't swing from your torso.
Don't hold your breath.
Don't rush through the rotation.

short_description: A single-arm overhead press alternated side to side that builds shoulder strength and stability.
how_to: Stand or sit with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms forward.
Press your right arm overhead until fully extended.
Lower it back to shoulder height, then press your left arm overhead.
Alternate sides with control.
Keep your core tight throughout.
correct: Keep your core braced on every rep.
Keep your elbow slightly in front of your ear at the top.
Keep your lower back from arching.
Lower each dumbbell with control.
mistakes: Don't lean sideways to press the weight up.
Don't lock out your elbow with a snap.
Don't shrug your shoulder at the top.
Don't rush the alternating tempo.

short_description: A standing rear leg raise that isolates and strengthens the glutes.
how_to: Stand tall with your feet together and your hands on a wall or your hips for balance.
Shift your weight onto your left foot.
Squeeze your right glute and kick your right leg straight back.
Hold briefly at the top, then lower with control.
Complete your reps on one side before switching.
correct: Keep your hips level throughout.
Keep your core engaged to avoid swaying.
Squeeze your glute at the top of each rep.
Keep your standing leg slightly soft.
mistakes: Don't arch your lower back to get more height.
Don't swing your leg up with momentum.
Don't tilt your hips to the side.
Don't let your torso collapse forward.

short_description: A wide-stance squat held at the bottom while raising your heels to target the inner thighs, glutes, and calves.
how_to: Set your feet wider than shoulder-width with your toes turned out.
Lower into a sumo squat and hold the position.
Raise both heels off the floor as high as you can.
Lower your heels back down with control.
Repeat the calf raise from the squat position.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your heels down as you lower into the squat.
Keep your chest tall and your back straight.
Control each calf raise up and down.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't drop too fast into the squat.
Don't round your lower back.
Don't bounce on your toes.

short_description: An on-all-fours glute kickback that isolates the glutes and hamstrings.
how_to: Start on your hands and knees with your wrists under your shoulders.
Keep your core braced and your back flat.
Drive your right foot straight back and up until your leg is parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your glute at the top, then lower with control.
Finish your reps on one side, then switch.
correct: Keep your hips square to the floor.
Keep your core engaged throughout.
Squeeze your glute at the top of each rep.
Keep your back flat, not arched.
mistakes: Don't arch your lower back to kick higher.
Don't rotate your hip out to the side.
Don't swing your leg with momentum.
Don't let your shoulders collapse.

short_description: A dynamic hamstring stretch performed by kicking your legs straight up as you walk forward.
how_to: Stand tall with your arms extended forward at shoulder height.
Step forward with your left foot.
Swing your right leg straight up to meet your outstretched left hand.
Lower your right foot and step forward, then swing the left leg up.
Continue alternating in a march-like pattern.
correct: Keep your kicking leg straight.
Keep your standing leg slightly soft.
Keep your torso upright and tall.
Move at a controlled, rhythmic pace.
mistakes: Don't round your back as you kick.
Don't swing your leg past your natural range.
Don't hold your breath.
Don't lean back to get more height.
